title: World Bloom — Searching for Sunken Shadows — Episode10 To Move Forward, Eventually

meta.Event Outline: Mafuyu is now living with Kanade after running away, and all four members of Nightcord at 25:00 are working together again. As they each turn their thoughts to the future, something begins to shift in the Empty SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Okay. Thank you, Amia.
We should be able to upload it soon at the pace we're going.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Thank goodness!
I'm glad my decision to cut back a little on the effects ended up being a good idea!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<I'm of the same opinion.
This seems to go a lot better with the melody's overall feel.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Oh, you think so?!
It must be pretty good if you like it that much, Enanan♪>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <While we're at it, Yuki, lemme hear what you think?! Do you like it?!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Relax, will you... But I guess we can throw you a bone this time.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <That reminds me. I've finished making a new demo, so I'd like for you to all listen to it...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <It's done? Then, let's listen to it with Miku and the others in SEKAI.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah! Oh, also...
Do you all know about the new area that appeared in SEKAI?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Yeah, I already went!
You're talking about the big lake, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, that! It's so strange how you can hear one of K's songs playing from it.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, um... I saw a place like that in a dream. A part of me is wondering if they're one and the same.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <So, I was helping a little girl look for her lost plushie... And we ended up by a lake together.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes. I'm not sure how else to describe it...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Interesting...
Then, let's go see if that's what you saw!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, does this mean your dream wasn't actually a dream?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Miku! You guys! You're all here too!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We can easily pass the time here.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, I get that.
You can play in the lake and draw if you have a pen.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Can you bring us some next time, Ena?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Come to think of it, this lake is kinda weird. I could've sworn that I saw something down there the last time I was here...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It might've been my imagination, but it definitely looked like one of my drawings...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, um...
That sketch of you, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, Miku, that children's picture book you guys were reading also came from the lake, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
And we can hear Kanade's song coming from it...
I've gotta think there's something else lurking around here.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Miku, how exactly did you guys get that book out of the lake?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I have a feeling that only Mafuyu can take things out of it...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: She may be right. This lake was born out of Mafuyu's feelings, so it would make sense that only she would be able to fish anything out of there.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Then, Mafuyu, wanna try grabbing something out of there?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: If you can't, then our hands are tied...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: However, this may also be a clue regarding how we're supposed to find the real you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: This lake very likely contains some sort of manifestation of who you really are.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Finding that may be having to relive some painful memories.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Kanade's song coming from the lake, as well as the picture book about the rabbit... They both mean quite a lot to you, do they not?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Finding more of those things could be the key to uncovering your true self.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, you may find some things down there that you do not want to see again.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But we'll be here if you do.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Your sketch of Mafuyu...!
I've seen pics of it before, but never the original.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wow, it was really inside the lake.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
And it isn't even wet...
How does that work...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: This time, it's sheet music for N25...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And those ones are from ages ago!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I remember these...
They're from back when Mafuyu was doing all the mixing for us.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Back then, I tried to find my true self, but realized that I couldn't on my own...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I thought that making songs with you would help me achieve my goal, Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: There may be more hidden down there...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(What is this...?
It's round and smooth...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, what did you find this time?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Can you sit up? You don't have to if you don't think you can.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Then why don't we do this...?
Open up for the airplane...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. My, aren't we full of demands today.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Of course, dear. Now, lie down for me, and take my hand...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Looks like it.
But what does it mean?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Come to think of it, Mafuyu, I think I made apple sauce for you that one time you caught a cold...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It took me a little while since I didn't really know how to then, but I felt much better after you ate it...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I don't want to think about what happened...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But I can't seem to let go of this apple...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I want to do more for others...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I want to be right by their side when they're in pain...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I... I think I need this to keep being me...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Is that something important to you, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm not sure, but I think it is...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whoa, you're right!
That wasn't there before, right?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
What's going on?
Should we go check it out?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hmm...
It looks like a regular door at first glance.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But was this door also born out of Mafuyu's feelings?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
But why just a door...?
It's not like we can go anywhere by opening it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No, it could be one of those doors that teleports us places!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Still, what could this door be for...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm... I'm not sure, but it appearing has to mean something, right?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We may see further changes take place if your feelings were to continue evolving or transforming, Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Not unlike how this door just appeared.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I know...
Change is a scary thing...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I mean, it goes without saying that you disappearing would be a problem for us at this point.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: She's right. If anything frightening does happen, we'll be there to face it with you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Me too. Thank goodness Mafuyu's feeling a little better now...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Things are starting to change a little bit at a time.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hey, you guys...
What's that by the lake...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: First this lake appears, and now we're seeing plants. Does this mean her feelings have undergone further changes?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This could be a sign of things to come...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I hope it grows big and tall...
